about_short_description.short_description: Votek is a software company specialized in developing high-tech and innovative solutions based on automatic Arabic speech recognition.

product.name: Arabic Speech Recognition Technology
product.description: A technology that recognizes continuous Arabic speech with 96% accuracy, including standard Arabic and dialects, customizable to specific domains.

product.name: Real-Time Transcription
product.description: Transcribes Arabic speech as it happens, suitable for live events or streaming.

product.name: Batch Transcription
product.description: Allows for the transcription of pre-recorded audio in bulk, useful for processing large volumes of audio files.

product.name: Accents and Dialects Recognition
product.description: The technology can recognize and differentiate between various Arabic accents and dialects.

product.name: On-Prem Deployment
product.description: The solution can be deployed on the client's premises for enhanced security and control.

product.name: Cloud Deployment
product.description: Offers flexibility by allowing the technology to be deployed on the cloud.
